algorithm_contract: Frozen RandomAR,DelayedDynamicRole,DelayedHybridOnly. Heuristic one-step search retains the old equal-weight throughput/coverage/fairness score; not energy-aware search. Real evaluation reward and physics match FourArm400k.
information_contract: Heuristics receive only original148D prefix of173D actor observations; extra25D delayed history map is unused. Delayed common report130D plus each own current state; no live truth or future rollout.
trace_hash_contract: H0=32 zero bytes; Ht=SHA256(Ht-1 || service-time UE positions float64 little endian C order)
scope: Three frozen baselines on reserved test seeds while DRL trains; no controller retuning from test. Later evaluate frozen DRL best selected by validation on exactly this environment contract.

replication.selection: Per training seed: best.pt by mean total reward on the fixed validation seeds. No selection by test or by best training seed.
replication.replication_scope: Three optimizer/network/exploration/replay seeds on the same declared training scenario schedule. This does not establish robustness to other maps, hardware or hyperparameters.
replication.presentation: Four DRL configurations plus two heuristic labels. Retain individual trained models as replicates, not separate algorithms.
replication.statistics: Equal weighting of training seeds and scenario seeds. Crossed bootstrap resamples paired training-seed indices and paired scenario indices separately. Three training seeds yield exploratory uncertainty estimates. Never count heuristic copies as independent observations.
